svg.text: Mercenaries 2 — one frame, from the world to the headset
Top: the forms the frame's data takes, each step performed by the function under its arrow. Below: the call trees that do it, per thread; a node's number is the step it performs.
MC2VR's parts are dashed tags. Per-address facts are on the Ghidra plates, the design in docs/. Generated by tools/diagrams/render_pipeline.py.
HOW THE WORLD BECOMES DRAW COMMANDS
the build and draw of one frame — runs one frame behind the update thread
the render worker: runs the frame's task nodes 0 → 3 → 4 → 2
per sub-view (records come from view 1), ~2–4.4 ms
camera entry from g_CameraTable → view = inverse, LH projection, VP
cull frustum widened to the HMD FOV (+5°)
view matrix, view frustum, 4 shadow cascades
fills the view-context records, then every renderable kind:
each with its own view context
brackets the world-marker and HUD record ranges
bloom, eye adaptation, composite into the front
quads noted; placed per eye at draw time
every emitter ends here: one 0x58-byte record each
new frame id: repoint the tables at this buffer
publishes the HUD / marker ranges with the list
sort → g_PrimitiveHead; flip the ping-pong buffer
the frame, as two complete passes over the same records
stereo: pass 1 LEFT, pass 2 RIGHT; one pose sample + lockstep gate
Present (previous frame) · BeginScene · GPU drain · bind + clear targets
Present only in pass 2; drain skipped in pass 2; MSAA
per pass: makes pass 2 a full re-submit
what changed since the last record
VS: screen, viewContextData, light, env, material, vsConst · PS: camera, light
the record's command stream: 27 ops (states, constants, targets, clears)
camera matrices in op 2 corrected per eye
world markers moved per eye, sized to 3°
pass 1: drawn once into the 1920×1080 HUD target
HUD panel composited 1.5 m ahead · eye image captured and shared
entry := HMD union pose (camera, culling, LOD)
host events drained; HUD mode switch
not the current frame's: update runs ~1 frame ahead
both eyes at the predicted display time
pose + FOV, IPD → read by the camera table and the lockstep gate
blit shared eye textures → swapchains → xrEndFrame
with the pair's own pose / FOV
All engine calls go through the Dx9_* caller-side caches. The carrier owns the front / depth targets and renders at the
device hooks: SetVertexShaderConstantF (camera channel) · SetRenderTarget (pass gate, MSAA) ·
SetDepthStencilSurface · SetTexture · StretchRect · Present · Reset · TestCooperativeLevel (render-size switch)
g_CameraTable, g_ViewTable, g_RenderQueue (its consumer is unlocated)
node 4 publishes the sorted records that node 2 draws
IPC pose: camera-table fill + pass-1 sample / lockstep gate; events at PostUpdateHook
shared eye textures + FRAME_READY per eye
